firmware.name: TouchBass
firmware.author: Synthux Academy
firmware.description: Official Synthux bass synth with arpeggiator for the Simple Touch.
firmware.notes:
## TouchBass
Source and binary: [Synthux-Academy/TouchBass](https://github.com/Synthux-Academy/TouchBass).

## Pads
- **P03–P09** · notes
- **P10 + P00 / P02** · arpeggiator slower / faster
- **P11 + P00 / P02** · previous / next scale (three scales)
- **P10 + P11** · mono / paraphonic

## Switches
- **S07-S08** · arpeggiator: up latch, centre on, down off
- **S09-S10** · Osc 2 mode: left plays it as a sound, centre and right use it for AM

## MIDI CC
| CC | Parameter |
|---|---|
| 71 | filter resonance |
| 72 | envelope |
| 74 | filter cutoff |
| 75 | Osc 1 freq |
| 76 | Osc 1 shape |
| 77 | Osc 2 freq |
| 78 | Osc 2 amount |
| 85 | pattern |
| 86 | note randomisation |
| 87 | envelope randomisation |
| 91 | reverb amount |
| 126 / 127 | mono / paraphonic |
